  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  MARCH 21, 2023

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Davis at 5:03 p.m., on
  Tuesday, March 21, 2023, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA.

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Gleam Davis
  Mayor Pro Tem Lana Negrete
  Councilmember Phil Brock
  Councilmember Oscar de la Torre
  Councilmember Christine Parra (arrived at 5:08 p.m.)
  Councilmember Caroline Torosis (arrived at 5:15 p.m.)
  Councilmember Jesse Zwick

  Also Present:  City Manager David White
  City Attorney Douglas Sloan
  City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

  CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 5:03 p.m., with all
  members present, except Councilmembers Parra and Torosis. City
  Manager David White led the assemblage in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  PUBLIC INPUT FOR  Members of the public Denise Barton and WaWa commented on closed
  CLOSED SESSION:  session items.
  Councilmember Parra
  arrived at 5:08 p.m.

  CLOSED SESSIONS  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 5:09 p.m., to consider
  Councilmember Torosis  closed sessions and returned at 5:39 p.m., with all members present, to
  arrived at 5:15 p.m.  report the following:

  3.A. PUBLIC EMPLOYEE - Government Code Section 54957(b):
  Consider the evaluation of performance of a public employee. Title:
  City Clerk

  The Mayor advised this matter was heard with no reportable action taken.

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 5:40 p.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Denise Anderson-Warren  Gleam Davis
  City Clerk  Mayor

  1  March 21, 2023
